intent: whether the results table contains the required flight column headers

action_params.query: whether the results table contains the required flight column headers
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i

intent: whether every listed flight row exposes a Choose This Flight action

action_params.condition: Each listed row exposes a "Choose This Flight" action.

action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows = Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('tr')).filter(r => r.querySelectorAll('td').length > 0); return rows.length > 0 && rows.every(r => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('button,input[type="submit"],a')).some(a => (a.textContent || a.value || '').trim() === 'Choose This Flight')); })()
locators: internal:text="Choose Flight # Airline Departs: Paris Arrives: New York Price Choose This"i
